snippets.title: Alternator output test
snippets.text: Charging system, alternator output test. Run the engine at 2000 rpm with loads on and measure output at the battery.

snippets.title: Lean codes at idle from cracked PCV hose
snippets.text: Some 2.0L engines may set lean codes at idle when the PCV hose cracks at the intake elbow. Inspect the hose at the elbow for cracks or a vacuum hiss with the engine idling.

snippets.title: Fuel pressure test
snippets.text: Fuel system, fuel pressure test. Key on, engine off, connect a gauge at the rail test port. Specified pressure is 55-62 psi and should hold for 5 minutes.

messages.content: 2015 compact sedan, 2.0L, 118k miles. Check engine light with P0171 (lean, bank 1). Rough idle, worst when cold.

snippets.title: Pulsation from rotor thickness variation
snippets.text: A pedal pulsation at highway braking may come from front rotor thickness variation. Measure rotor thickness at eight points around the rotor with a micrometer and compare the spread to the 0.0005 in. limit.

snippets.title: Brake fluid level and condition
snippets.text: Check the brake fluid level at the reservoir and test moisture content with a test strip.

messages.content: 2018 midsize crossover, 64k miles. Steering wheel shakes when braking from highway speed.
Check the brake fluid level at the reservoir and its moisture content with a test strip [SM 6.2.1].
Fluid is full and the strip reads fine. The shake is only when I brake hard from 70.
None of the references cover a vibration that only appears above highway speed, so I can't point to a documented step yet. Does the pedal itself pulse, or only the steering wheel?
The pedal pulses too. Just tell me what part to replace, I don't want more tests.
